text:
maria_marketing: Need a tight 1‑page cheat sheet for enterprise buyers comparing Hosted / Dedicated / Private with a focus on security, SLA, and latency tradeoffs. Goal: field-ready by Fri EOD. Keep it scannable.

Tom_product: Proposed sections: quick headline + one stat, 3-column matrix (security | SLA | latency), routing playbook (3 bullets), short benchmark note, 15s webinar pitch, and a single CTA.

lee_sales: Persona: platform + security + infra procurement. Include a sales nudge: when to escalate from SDR -> AE -> Solutions Eng.

rachel_design: I can do layout. Prefer horizontal rule separators and large iconography for Security/SLA/Latency. Need final copy Wed.

maria_marketing: Example hero stat idea: "Predictable inference at scale: reduce P95 variance by up to 50% with Dedicated." Keep conservative and add measurement context.

Tom_product: Benchmark blurb (short):
```
Benchmark note: On a 60-token chat prompt under sustained 150 rps, Dedicated P50=55ms P95=110ms; Hosted P50=75ms P95=230ms. Private on-prem depends on GPU and network; typical range P95 8060ms+ (A100700 series). Measurements include prefix cache enabled.
```

lee_sales: Routing playbook (3 quick bullets for SDRs):
- If >1M tokens/mo OR requires SOC2+/HIPAA -> route to AE.
- If needs VPC, HSM, or on-prem -> route to Solutions Eng.
- If latency P95 <150ms is must-have -> mark for Dedicated trial.

maria_marketing: Sales one-liner for emails: "Avoid inference surprises: clear SLAs, private deployment options, and predictable tail latency." Keep it short.

rachel_design: Callout copy for "When to pick Dedicated" (<=18 words): "Choose Dedicated for stable P95, guaranteed capacity, and isolated data handling for regulated workloads."

ops-bot: Reminder set for Fri publish deadline. :calendar:

Tom_product: Webinar blurb (10-15s): "Join our 30-min session: LLM serving for regulated apps 10 minutes of benchmarks, deployment tradeoffs, and live Q&A. Register link coming."

lee_sales: I'll dig up an anonymized quote about stability to put in the callout box.

maria_marketing: Great. Keep language plain and avoid deep tech jargon in the main column. Tech variant can live in appendix. Thanks all.
